passive.name: Garden of Thorns
passive.resolvedDescription: Seeds spawn around Zyra periodically, becoming faster with level. Zyra can cast Deadly Spines or Grasping Roots near seeds to grow plants, who fight for Zyra.

Q.name: Deadly Spines
Q.resolvedDescription: Zyra causes thick vines to spread and explode into spines, dealing 60/100/140/180/220 (+65% AP) magic damage. If this Ability is cast near a Seed, the Seed grows into a Thorn Spitter that deals {{ spell.zyrap:plantdamage }} magic damage and lasts {{ spell.zyrap:plantduration }} seconds. Thorn Spitters have 575 range.

W.name: Rampant Growth
W.resolvedDescription: Zyra plants a Seed that lasts 60 seconds. These Seeds grant True Sight of enemy champions that step on them for 2 seconds, but are still destroyed. This Ability has 2 charges with a {{ ammorechargetime }} second recharge time. Killing an enemy minion or monster reduces the recharge time by 35%. Champion takedowns reduce the recharge time by 100% instead.

E.name: Grasping Roots
E.resolvedDescription: Zyra sends vines forward, Rooting for 1/1.25/1.5/1.75/2 second(s) and dealing 60/95/130/165/200 (+60% AP) magic damage. If this Ability passes near a Seed, the Seed grows into a Vine Lasher that deals {{ spell.zyrap:plantdamage }} magic damage and lasts {{ spell.zyrap:plantduration }} seconds. Vine Lashers have 400 range, and their Attacks Slow by 30% for 2 seconds. The Slow from multiple Vine Lashers stacks up to 2 times.

R.name: Stranglethorns
R.resolvedDescription: Zyra summons the fury of nature, growing a twisted thicket that deals 200/300/400 (+70% AP) magic damage. After 2 seconds, the vines snap upwards, Knocking Up for 1 second. Zyra's plants within the thicket become enraged, resetting their duration, gaining 50% Health and Attacking for 50% bonus damage.
